# tec

> Tools to inspect python objects


## Pages

- [tec](index.html.md): Tools to inspect python objects
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;tec&#96;   |    |
- [tec](_autosummary/tec.html.md): | &#96;dependencies&#96;                             | Tools to analyze dependencies between python objects....
- [tec.dependencies](_autosummary/tec.dependencies.html.md): Tools to analyze dependencies between python objects.
- [tec.doctest_utils](_autosummary/tec.doctest_utils.html.md): Doctest utils (moved to test2doc)
- [tec.findimports](_autosummary/tec.findimports.html.md): Deprecated compatibility layer – use &#96;tec.imports&#96; instead.
- [tec.import_counting](_autosummary/tec.import_counting.html.md): Counting dependencies.
- [tec.imports](_autosummary/tec.imports.html.md): Find the imports of python code, using the standard library’s &#96;ast&#96;.
- [tec.misc](_autosummary/tec.misc.html.md): Misc tools.
- [tec.misc.manage_pth_file](_autosummary/tec.misc.manage_pth_file.html.md): Utils to manage .pth file, which is read by environment to add paths to the python path.
- [tec.modules](_autosummary/tec.modules.html.md): Tools to explore modules
- [tec.packages](_autosummary/tec.packages.html.md): A few functions to investigate what objects can be imported from a module
- [tec.peek](_autosummary/tec.peek.html.md): Peek at Python objects: print their source code and signatures.
- [tec.pip_packaging](_autosummary/tec.pip_packaging.html.md): Tools for pip packaging: create GitHub repos, look up PyPI versions, and
- [tec.pip_requirements](_autosummary/tec.pip_requirements.html.md): Tools to read and analyze pip requirements files as tabular data.
- [tec.pkg_code](_autosummary/tec.pkg_code.html.md): Tools to analyze local code files for packages.
- [tec.snake_food_import_counting](_autosummary/tec.snake_food_import_counting.html.md): Count and analyze module imports, snakefood-style (via static analysis).
- [tec.stores](_autosummary/tec.stores.html.md): (dol) stores (i.e. mapping interfaces) to access python files
- [tec.util](_autosummary/tec.util.html.md): Builtin tec utils
